sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The separator role conveys a meaningful content boundary; surrounding section headings/text provide the boundary context. No fictitious label is required for a non-focusable separator.
updatesAndDescendants: Base UI renders a non-focusable div role=separator and derives orientation from props. It has no adjustable value, keyboard operation or action callback. A purely decorative line can instead be hidden deliberately in its own context.
referenceDecision: This reference chooses an informative non-focusable separator. It does not silently classify all separators as decorative or turn the line into a splitter.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
